ED_Title: Strengthening the role of mediation in the peaceful settlement of disputes, conflict prevention and resolution
ED_DecisionText: At its 115th plenary meeting, on 4 September 2026, the General Assembly decided to include the item entitled “Strengthening the role of mediation in the peaceful settlement of disputes, conflict prevention and resolution” in the draft agenda of the eighty-first session.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
